canal.originalPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished pixel-art landscape backdrop for a cozy Japanese fishing videogame, wide 2:1 canvas, one scene only.
Primary request: A flowing rural irrigation canal beside a rustic Japanese timber waterwheel house, with golden-green rice paddies in the distance, seen at fisher eye height from the near bank. Richly detailed handcrafted pixel art: crisp clustered pixels, tiny wildflowers, weathered timber, old gray stone retaining edges, teal water, honey-gold evening light, deep olive foliage and warm earth. Match the visual spirit of a highly detailed 16-bit rural Japanese RPG environment.
Composition: camera is low on the dry near bank looking outward across a broad fishable water surface, NOT overhead, NOT isometric. Put the small waterwheel house and wooden wheel in the upper left distance, the paddies and low hills in a very narrow strip at the top. The waterwheel creates modest flowing ripples. Broad uncluttered teal canal water must fill the central 15% through 83% of image height, especially across the central 70% of width, providing space for fishing gameplay. Small banks and vegetation may frame the outer sides only. Bottom 17% of the canvas is a continuous DRY sandy earthen bank, clear in the middle all the way to bottom edge, with scattered pebbles and small flowers toward the corners; an angler will stand at bottom center later. Do not put foreground water at bottom center. Keep a wide plausible canal rather than a narrow ditch.
Lighting: serene golden evening, warm reflective accents against cool teal water, rich but restrained colors. Full-bleed landscape, no borders, no collage, no panels. No people, no angler, no fishing equipment, no animals, no letters, no text, no UI, no logos, no watermark.
